title: 遠足と防災のフレーム
subject_en: Decorative frames/borders with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, landscape or square, thick enough to hold text or a photo, decorated with the motifs of the theme. Flat colourful style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 遠足の持ち物や防災用品で縁取った、12点の飾り枠です。学校や園のおたより、防災マップ、掲示物に使えます。
items: リュックと水筒の遠足枠

circular wreath of hiking items and leaves
frame made of emergency kit, helmet, flashlight and water bottles
frame with safety hood, whistle and radio
frame with evacuation arrows and a shelter symbol, no text
wide frame with a first-aid kit, blanket and a flashlight
tall portrait frame with emergency items stacked on both sides
